title: Admin
review_notes: Review notes (required when rejecting or requesting changes)
invalid_slug: Use a lowercase slug with letters, numbers, and hyphens.
invalid_hex: Enter a six-digit color such as #123abc.
invalid_mimes: Enter at least one valid MIME type (for example, image/png).
locations_help: Edit pickup details and prices, or deactivate a location without losing its order history.
no_locations: No locations yet. Add one to enable pickup.
deactivate_location_confirm: Hide this location from new orders? Existing orders stay intact.
coordinates_pair: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both blank.
invalid_timezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as Asia/Hong_Kong.
currency_hint: Checkout charges in the location's currency and the storefront formats every price with it. Hong Kong locations use HKD; a location abroad keeps its own code.
invalid_country: Use a two-letter country code such as HK.
no_sales_tax_hint: {{country}} has no sales tax, so orders collected here are never taxed.
tax_hint: Sales tax is added at checkout using the country and rate of this location.
filament_help: Deactivate a color to remove it everywhere; use stock below to control each location separately.
stock_help: Choose a location, then tick the colors that are actually in stock.
products_help: Create drafts, add product images, choose allowed materials, then publish. Archive instead of deleting products with order history.
model_required: Upload a model file for a new product.
model_invalid: Choose an STL, OBJ, or 3MF model.
image_invalid: Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.
images_hint: One existing image URL per line; uploaded product images are added automatically.
publish_requires_material: To publish, allow at least one material and choose an active default material from that list.
default_material_invalid: The default material must also be allowed on the product.
archive_hint: Drafts and archived products are hidden from the catalog. Existing orders retain their snapshots.
options_help: Configure selection choices, text fields, or customer file uploads.
option_type_fixed: Option type cannot change after creation; add a new group instead.
orders_help: Browse all orders by status and location, or search by order number/email.
cancel_reason_required: Enter a reason when cancelling an order.
cancel_not_refund: Cancelling an order does not refund its payment. Use Refund payment for a Stripe refund.
refund_confirm: Refund the Stripe payment for order {{order}}? This cannot be undone.
users_help: Browse accounts or search by email. Edit roles and location assignments or disable sign-in.
user_roles_hint: Staff and managers need an active location. Admins can work across all locations without an assignment.
staff_location_required: Assign an active location to staff and managers.
invite_hint: Leave the password blank to send an email invitation. For local testing only, set a temporary password (at least 8 characters) and share it securely. Existing customers can be promoted by email.
payouts_help: Review creator requests and record a transfer reference before marking a payout paid.
reference_required: Enter the transfer reference before marking this payout paid.
offers_help: Campaign codes issue personal coupons when customers claim them on the Offers page.
invalid_offer_code: Offer codes must be 4–32 uppercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
claims_below_used: The limit cannot be lower than the number already claimed.
invalid_date_range: The end date must be after the start date.
coupons_help: Issue a single-use coupon for an account, or leave email blank for a bearer code anyone can use.
coupon_needs_discount_or_points: Enter a discount or a positive points amount.
invalid_coupon_code: Coupon codes must be 6–32 uppercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
offer_conditions_hint: Claiming this code issues a coupon with the same minimum spend and product restriction.
generation_failed: No codes were generated. Try again.
bulk_help: Creates single-use codes in one go, with no typing and no duplicates. Leave the prefix blank for plain random codes.
invalid_prefix: Use up to 12 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
codes_copy_hint: If copying is blocked, select the list below and copy it manually.
user_not_found: No account uses that email address.
expire_coupon_confirm: Expire this coupon immediately? This cannot be undone.
settings_help: Save each value separately. Pricing changes apply to future orders; past orders do not change.
redeem_help: Set the base earn rate and the coupons customers can redeem with points. Reward coupons are valid for one year.
redeem_section_help: Customers trade points for these single-use coupons on the Rewards page.
redeem_product_hint: Choose a product to make the coupon apply to that item only; 100% gives the item away free.
redeem_required: Add at least one redemption option.
duplicate_points: Each option must use a different points amount.

fields.name: Name
fields.address_placeholder: Shop 1, G/F, 18 Aberdeen Street, Central, Hong Kong
fields.title: Title

bootstrap_hint: First admin only: if this is the confirmed account configured by the operator, activate it here. Otherwise ask an existing admin for access.
review_adjust_hint: Review the base price and allowed materials before approval. You can edit the published product later in Products.
review_notes_required: Add review notes before rejecting or requesting changes.
language_help: English is required. Text left empty in another language falls back to English.
sale_help: Customers see the regular price struck through with the sale price next to it. Leave the dates empty for an open-ended sale.
sale_below_price: The sale price must be lower than the regular price.
sale_below_modifier: The sale price must be lower than the regular modifier.
choice_sale_help: Discounts this choice while the sale runs; customers see the regular modifier struck through.
linked_slot_help: Link parts of this product to share one material and color choice.
linked_slot_invalid: Choose a different unlinked part to share material settings.
material_slots_help: For prints made of more than one material: each slot is a named part the customer picks a material and colour for. With no slots the product keeps its single material and colour picker.
slot_materials: Materials this slot can be printed in
single_material_hint: Used when the product has no material slots.
slot_needs_material: Slot {{number}}: choose at least one material.
slot_default_required: Slot {{number}}: choose a default material from this slot's list.
slot_default_inactive: Slot {{number}}: the default material must be active to publish.
slot_default_color_invalid: Slot {{number}}: the default colour must be a colour of the default material.
staff_scope_hint: You are signed in with specific permissions. Only the tools you have been granted are shown.
categories_help: Products and submissions pick from these categories. Rename one and every product follows; deactivate one to hide it from the storefront filter.
delete_category_confirm: Delete the category “{{name}}”? Products still using it must be moved first.
category_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Used in links and filters.
fallback_category_hint: “other” is the fallback category: it cannot be renamed, deactivated or deleted.
jobs_help: Published listings appear on the careers page until their closing date. Drafts stay private to staff.
job_visibility_hint: Published listings show on /careers until their closing date. Drafts stay private to staff.
finish_help: How the filament looks beyond its colour: silk, matte, wood grain, glow, gradient and so on.
permissions_help: Grant only the modules this staff member needs. Full admin powers override every other permission.

permission_descriptions.admin_full: Everything below, plus users, settings and payouts.
permission_descriptions.products_manage: Products, categories, materials, filaments and stock.
permission_descriptions.coupons_manage: Coupons, offer codes and points redemption options.
permission_descriptions.jobs_manage: Careers job listings and their published state.
permission_descriptions.quotes_manage: Quotation requests and quote/help tickets, chain-wide.
permission_descriptions.orders_manage: Read and update orders at every location.
permission_descriptions.users_manage: Invite staff, edit accounts and assign these permissions.
permission_descriptions.payouts_manage: Review creator earnings and settle payouts.
permission_descriptions.locations_manage: Pickup locations, map pins, currency and tax.
permission_descriptions.settings_manage: Platform settings, feature switches and membership tiers.

tiers_help: The four lifetime-points thresholds are fixed. Edit tier names and multipliers; lifetime points come from orders and are never reduced by redemptions.
option_label_delete_hint: Deleting a label leaves existing product groups intact, but they will need a new label if edited.
